preferred_ambiguous_aliases.decision: Boiled potato without skin is the intentional default for the ambiguous NL alias aardappel.
Cooked plain pasta is the intentional default for the ambiguous NL alias pasta.
Cooked white long-grain rice is the intentional default for the ambiguous NL alias rijst.
Baked sweet-potato flesh is the intentional default for zoete aardappel.
USDA 2% reduced-fat milk is the closest approved generic record; the label keeps 2% explicit. It is the intentional generic melk default.
Prepared 93% lean ground turkey is the intentional default for kalkoengehakt.
Prepared skinless chicken breast is the intentional default for the ambiguous NL alias kipfilet.
Prepared lean top-round beef is the intentional default for mager rundvlees.
Prepared Atlantic salmon is the intentional default for the ambiguous NL alias zalm.

coverage_gaps.reason: No approved generic USDA identity preserves Dutch quark composition and product meaning.
No approved generic USDA identity preserves Dutch quark composition and product meaning.
No defensible generic non-branded USDA Skyr identity exists in the pinned accepted datasets.
